title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You

meta.Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Next, let's stretch our backs!
Put your hands together above your head and raise them like you're a little sprout popping out of the ground.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sprout! Sprout!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Sprout! Sprout!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To finish, stretch out your arms and make big circles with them! Like a pair of giant flowers blooming, Minorinrin♪

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Minorinrin♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's it for our Minorin stretches!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you for showing us that, Minori.
I thought it was a very cute and energizing warm-up♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You did this at the training camp, didn't you? I have to think everyone watching really enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it was a huge hit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To be fair, I wouldn't have been able to come up with it if it weren't for Hikarin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Hikarin?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. At first, we were doing normal morning stretches with the viewers using that one radio program.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We decided to do that because some people said in the comments during our morning practice that they were still sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But then, Hikarin zoomed in like a shooting star, and now I'm having a lot of trouble forgetting what she did...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The “big bang hyperspace jump” and the “interplanetary neck roll”, yes...? They were both so fun and powerful.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Hikarin really is a one of a kind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I felt that I needed to do the same! I gave it a lot of thought and came up with my own Minorin stretches!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That whole process was really fun since I was also able to get everyone posting their ideas in the comments.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I'm sure everyone watching had no trouble waking up after that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And all of that allowed you to become closer with them and have fun together... That's the MORE MORE JUMP! way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I was a little nervous when the grand prix got underway, but I've really gotten used to things now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, moving forward, we're just gonna be ourselves as we try to spread hope to as many people as we can!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We know you will! And we'll always be here to give you girls support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, Minori, I think that the four of you have already spread quite a lot of hope during this grand prix.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right, Rin?♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...?
There's some deeper meaning to that, isn't there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind explaining what?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Lately, it seems like the tree's been growing even bigger!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku and I took a walk earlier, and we saw that it'd grown some new leaves!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must be because you've all been working very hard to make your dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, if it really has grown, then we should go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!
Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What do we do?!
The leaves have gone all droopy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What if we cheered for it?!
Would that help make it better?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'll join you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Calm down, you two...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Cheering could work...
But these leaves appear to be covered in some sort of black substance. Maybe that's the cause?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He's right. What could it possibly be?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They look like fragments of feelings, but... They don't look very nice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, these fragments seem to be...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, we can't just sit here and do nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If these black fragments are the cause, then I'd like to remove them immediately, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... But they seem to be stuck on there pretty good. I'm worried that we'd damage the tree in the process.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we might be able to remove these ones without hurting it! Just gotta give it a little force, and...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
Minori, get away from there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_idol_op1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Huh...? Where am I...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Hey, quit spacing out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry...!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
Hey, are you feeling okay?
There's a ton of people here, so you gotta be careful, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Also, you dropped some of your show flyers. C'mon, lemme help you pick them up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Flyers...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... That's right! I was passing out flyers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our show's just around the corner, so we gotta attract as many people as we can to come and watch!

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Wait, did you forget what you were doing?

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
Are you really sure you're okay?
If you aren't feeling well, then we could help you with your quota.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay!
I promise to make up for spacing out by going full power from here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello! We're Pop☆Drop, and we're doing a show next week! Come and watch us if you're interested!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We promise to fill you with lots of encouraging energy! We'd really appreciate your support!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Pop☆Drop? Do you know them?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: No, never heard of them. They're probably underground idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, our group's concept involves giving everybody a big boost of energy and—

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Oh, sorry, I'm not interested.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Yikes, she's trying to talk to us. Let's get outta here.
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line: How long is this gonna last?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line: We debuted a year ago, but we're still having trouble attracting guests. Even when we do perform on stage, the more popular members always end up overshadowing us.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member B
rows.Line: That's on top of our agency playing favorites. While we're here passing out flyers, the select group is doing that magazine interview today, right?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line:
To be fair, it is a free magazine...
*Sigh*
Is this really worth the effort?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (You guys...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I get what they're saying.
I also worry sometimes that nothing is gonna change no matter how hard I try.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's true that not many people are coming to see us at the moment...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we'll be performing in front of big crowds someday, as long as we don't give up!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, let's keep trying our best!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah, but when's that gonna be...?
We've invested all this energy already and gotten nothing in return...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And people will understand someday!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member B
rows.Line: Haha. You always say that, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line:
But yeah, you're right...
Thanks. I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our best to hand out the rest of these flyers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I was able to cheer them up!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm also feeling a little better now as a result.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It just goes to show how amazing Haruka's words are. Even now, they're able to cheer people up like this.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I was so shocked when I first heard that she'd be retiring from being an idol, but...)
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I managed to get here just in time. But who can blame me for cutting it a little close today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I mean, I did it...!
I finally passed an audition!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Those forty-nine other times, there were times I thought to myself that it was never going to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I have Haruka to thank for pushing me to not give up. I owe her so much!)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Minori! Did you see the news?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I made the decision to pay it forward by taking the hope she gave me and spreading it to more people!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (In order to get even just a little bit closer to the idol that Haruka was.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello! We're Pop☆Drop!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Please come and see our show!
We absolutely promise to blow you away!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'd really appreciate your support!
A few days later
Live House

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Lead
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys!
What did you all think of today's show?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: You shined brighter than everyone else in the world again today, Rittan!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: I'm definitely coming back again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wow...! They're waving around their glow sticks like crazy!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (How many are in my color? Let's see...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (One, two... Three!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
My usual fans all came back again today...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But that number hasn't increased since we debuted...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No, I shouldn't think that.
I have fans who've been cheering for me this past year. That alone makes me really happy!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I'm gonna spread hope to lots and lots of people the way Haruka did...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Then I've gotta keep trying harder and harder...!)

Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to get better...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As I am now, I can't get lots of people to look my way or spread hope to them the way Haruka could...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I've decided that I'm going to get better no matter what!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to stand on stage, shine in the spotlight and get people to believe in a better tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's the kind of idol I wanna be...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oww... I tripped.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh oh. I think I twisted my ankle a little...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I have to treat this first...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What am I doing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I need to keep trying harder, but I hurt myself by tripping...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka never would've...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Am I ever going to be like her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, stop!
Quit being so negative!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Tomorrow will always be a better day!”
My goal is to be an idol who conveys that message.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which means I can't give up...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've decided that I'm going to succeed no matter what. I have to keep moving forward until I become that idol...
I'm certain that somebody out there will feel inspired by the way you're always doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Was someone trying to cheer me up just now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did I imagine that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But, yes.
As long as I keep trying, then I'm sure...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, dance practice can wait until tomorrow. Today, I'll work on my singing!

Live House

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Okay, I seem to be projecting my voice better than usual!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I feel like I can see the faces of everyone in the crowd better for some reason. Is it because my mind's more at ease now?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know that not many of them are here to see me...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I need to keep doing my best so that they feel encouraged when they see me dancing!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, that person's looking my way...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Did it work...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're waving back at me with their glow sticks...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Alright, I've gotta keep doing more and more...!)
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Minori's line is this way, and she's ready to see you right away! Feel free to enter if you have a meet-and-greet ticket!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Is this meet and greet gonna end with only like three people coming to see me again...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to talk to more of our guests...but I guess I should be thankful about the ones I have been able to meet.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Because them showing their support for me has filled me with a lot of encouragement!)

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line:
You were amazing again today YuiYui!
I couldn't take my eyes off of you because of how cute you looked!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Your dancing was super sharp again today, Rittan! I felt really inspired by you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What would Haruka do...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (How would she deal with this sort of situation?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If she thought that she'd connected with someone, but really hadn't... If she knew she had to keep trying, but started to get worried instead...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Did Haruka ever find herself in a situation like that...?)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Excuse me, Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Yes! I'm one of Rittan's fans, but... I thought you really shined today, Minori! That's why I decided to come and meet you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?! I shined today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Me?! Really?! Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, really!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: I've actually always admired your incredible work ethic. But you seemed more cheerful than usual today, and your smile was so dazzling...

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Before I knew it, my eyes had become glued to you.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line:
I was feeling a bit down...
But you gave me the energy I needed to keep going!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hearing you say that makes me so...
Super duper spectacularly happy!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but that's time.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, see you later...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-See you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm! Please feel free to come and see me again! It's okay if you go and meet Rittan first...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing more and more to cheer you up!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll be rooting for you!
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I don't know if I'll ever be the kind of idol Haruka was.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No matter how hard I try, it may never happen.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I can cheer someone up like this...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Then I have to keep doing everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (In the belief that I can do even better tomorrow!)

rows.Line: You seem awfully happy this morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, that's great.

rows.Line: Hi, Honda! How can we help you?

rows.Line: I'm volunteering for this event out in the country, but we're a bit shorthanded... Would either of you be interested?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In volunteering?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, the class reps organize that, right?
Like when Otori was trying to recruit people to pull weeds.

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it! We'll be playing with some kids at the local children's center, as well as tutoring them.

rows.Line: Wow, that sounds like fun...!

rows.Line: It takes place on the last Saturday of the month. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sorry, I can't. I have practice that day.

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: I know how packed your schedule is, Hinomori. But how about you, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm free that day, so I'd like to go!

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: Thanks! Then, I'll let the person in charge know. No, wait. Maybe you should go tell her yourself...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: Hehe. Because the leader of this event is someone you absolutely adore.

rows.Speaker: Honda
rows.Line: Haruka Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaaaat?!

rows.Line:
That concludes this homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I don't have any extracurricular activities scheduled for today, so I might make that poster for the children's center before going home...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And then, I'll start getting ready for that volunteer nursing home visit.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm really glad that I decided to try my hand at something new.)

rows.Line: (And I really need to thank Mom again for giving me the push I needed.)
A few months earlier

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You got the highest scores out of all the second-years on those tests we took the other day, didn't you, Haruka?! You're so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The things I studied just happened to show up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you always make sure to review the things we cover in class and read ahead, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You even show us your notes from time to time! I can't tell you how much I respect you since I tend to space out after getting tired from practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I didn't do very well on math this time around because of that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two have been working very hard in preparation for your next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have! And we need to keep practicing if we really want to move the hearts of the people who come and watch us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. Would you like it if I helped you with the parts you struggled with on those tests...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I was actually just thinking about looking over what came up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, thanks...! Then, it'll be a study session with just the three of us! That means we gotta go buy a bunch of snacks♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's fine, but our main goal going to be study.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Okay, this should be enough information for me to smoothly explain the key points behind each type of test question.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The amazing ones are Tenma and her band.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Because they're always doing what they can to give their audience the best shows possible...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (While I...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Haruka? Do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... Yeah, I can talk.
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Guess what...? There's an article in the evening paper about your favorite person. Remember her? She made you smile and laugh so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I didn't just smile and laugh...
She became my hero and gave me a dream.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't face her anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: You can choose whether or not to read this article, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Maybe just a quick skim...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“Although she's retired from being an idol and stepped away from the spotlight, she continues to spread hope to others...”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“Now, following her retirement, she's become a radio personality for a station in another part of the country. However, her activities are not confined to a cramped studio.”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“Between retirement homes, kindergartens, hot springs and such, she uses her past experience as a star to stand on stages all over her region...”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“And so, she continues to spread hope and inspire courage in others with her dazzling smile and beautiful voice.”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
She hasn't changed at all...
Just look at the way she's smiling while being surrounded by these children.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Her smile really is rosy...
It has this way of filling your heart with joyous light...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even now, she's spreading hope to lots of people.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She really is an amazing person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wish...I could've been like her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: If you feel that way... Why don't you give it another try?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Reading this article, I realized that there are many ways to make people smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Which means... You may yet find the path that's just right for you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I never thought about spreading hope to others without being an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What if I rob someone of their hope again...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to put you on the spot like that. You don't have to answer right away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Regardless of what you choose to do, you'll have my support. Please take your time and prioritize your own feelings.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I don't know if there's anything I can do for other people anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But if there's even the slightest possibility...)

I mean, you all fell asleep after touching them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Luka said that they might've been fragments of feelings... But if she's right, what feelings caused them to manifest?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't know... But a part of me was always anxious while we were in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was finally able to pass an audition and become an idol like I always wanted, but things didn't go all that well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I kept wondering if I'd ever be able to spread hope to people as an idol the way Haruka did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I felt that the entire time as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I felt anxiety about whether I'd ever become the idol that I wanted to be, as well as guilt and regret about my original decision to quit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means those sorts of feelings may've been involved.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't say for certain, but those sorts of negative feelings may've coalesced to form those black fragments...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which would explain why you all ended up having that terrible dream.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that dream also helped me realize something important!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Something important?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Even if we're pursuing different paths in life, no matter how hard things get...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll all still want to give hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We realized just how important that is to us. It never went away regardless of how hard we tried to suppress it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. I also remembered just how much MORE MORE JUMP! means to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm able to spread hope while just being myself because all of you accept me for who I am.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... We've been able to support each other and make up for each others' shortcomings because we're working together as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As idols who spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You two look like you're ready to cry, Miku, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That's because...!
After hearing what happened, I'm really glad that they all met...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why aren't you guys including yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Remember what we said that other time?! You guys are all members of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even during that dream, I could hear you guys trying to cheer us up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your guys' empathy and support mean so much to us that, even while we were dreaming, you were able to reach us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We wouldn't have been able to make it this far without you guys. So, once again, I'm really, really glad that you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: With this group of people, we should be able to go after any dream we like. So...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's do it...
Let's become idols who can spread lots of hope to lots of people!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, on that note, why don't we do our usual thing...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You'll all join us, yes, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More and more songs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More and more energy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More and more hope!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: May our songs reach more, more, more people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: JUMP!
